title: Rippers Unmasked — UI Theme
description: An opt-in, toggleable whole-app Foundry VTT theme in the Rippers Unmasked "Slash" register (near-black ground, blood-red accents, bone text; Grenze Gotisch / Pirata One / IBM Plex Mono / Spectral). Restyles the interface chrome — sidebar, windows, dialogs, chat, scene controls, navigation, players list, hotbar, tooltips, context menus, and form controls — to match the character sheet (rippers-guise) and the Stylish Action HUD theme (rippers-stylish-hud). Look only: no mechanics, no DOM/behaviour changes. Toggle it in Configure Settings ▸ Module Settings; there is no core theme-picker API in v13/v14, so it is a module setting, not an entry in Foundry's Color Scheme dropdown. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-theme.note: Ships a client-scoped toggle (Configure Settings > Module Settings) whose onChange toggles the class .rippers-theme on <html>; all CSS is scoped under html.rippers-theme so it is opt-in, never force-applied. No public v13/v14 registerTheme API exists (CONST.CSS_THEMES is frozen), so this is the supported toggleable path. Overrides core --color-* variables plus targeted chrome selectors. LOOK ONLY.
